description: Future MMIR.ai contribution reward concept for the Intelligence Well. This is product positioning only, not a payment, wallet or issuance implementation.

items.title: Contribute capacity
items.description: Approved users may later contribute trusted local compute, RAM, GPU, LLMs or VM capacity to the Intelligence Well.

items.title: Measure contribution
items.description: Backend telemetry must measure uptime, capacity, successful work, quality and policy compliance before any reward logic exists.

items.title: Earn utility credits
items.description: Contributors may later earn utility credits for approved contribution, usable toward compute, LLM time or higher service tiers.

items.title: Safe by design
items.description: No wallets, payment credentials, issuance logic or claims about external value belong in the public frontend.
